name: producer-declares-newer-version-warns
description: a producer declaring a newer minor of the line this client implements is served, not rejected — the consumer proceeds under the processing model and warns
kill: drop the RUN_STARTED.protocolVersion comparison, so a newer producer declaration passes unremarked

dotnet.intentional: .NET does not implement the version-declaration comparison, and RUN_STARTED carrying a newer protocolVersion is otherwise an ordinary recognised event, so the replay is silent. `warnings` is emptied only to displace the base expectation — an override replaces a key rather than removing it — and `noWarnings` is what asserts the silence. Alignment tracked separately.
